name: Sort-A-Smurf
summary:
Learn to recycle waste the Smurfy way!

Sort-A-Smurf is a free VR experience designed to make learning about waste sorting fun and engaging. Step into the tiny white shoes of a Smurf and collect and sort garbage across three Smurf houses, culminating in a surprise boss level inside Gargamel’s lair.

With the charm of the Smurfs, intuitive gameplay, and a strong educational core, Sort-A-Smurf shows how VR can make real-world learning feel like play.
